name: Riley M. Moore
bio: Riley McGowan Moore is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for West Virginia's 2nd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the 25th West Virginia State Treasurer from 2021 to 2025 and represented district 67 in the West Virginia House of Delegates from 2017 to 2019.
